title: Connect the Web Terminal to the reserved account and prove it
description: Web Terminal block: start a fresh slot browser, open the market's order page and connect the reserved fixture account (terminal.perps.ensure-session), then prove the app really holds that connection: the page's own provider answers eth_accounts with the reserved address first, the header shows it, and no Connect wallet button remains. With signer=injected the strict wallet answers eth_accounts with its account either way, so there the header is the connection proof. Listing the fixture accounts is not proof of a connection; this reads what the app got. Does not trade.

session.intent: Start a fresh slot browser and connect the reserved account to the Web Terminal

assert_connected.intent: Prove the Web Terminal is connected to the reserved account, as its own provider and header report

capture.label: connected-{{params.account}}
capture.intent: Keep a picture of the header showing the connected account

signer.description: extension: the real MetaMask extension confirms the connection (acceptance mode). injected: the strict test wallet answers it (fast mode).

account.description: Wallet fixture account reserved for this slot (dev1 on mmt-1, Trading on mmt-2).

market.description: Testnet market whose order page opens.
